scenarios.title: National - satisfaction decline
scenarios.blurb: The full dataset. A sustained 11-week drop in customer satisfaction.
scenarios.headline: Review Score fell 0.324 (4.23 to 3.90). Leading cause: Delivery performance degraded, and that degradation drove the satisfaction drop.

scenarios.title: Santa Catarina - ambiguous evidence
scenarios.blurb: A real movement the evidence cannot attribute to a single cause.
scenarios.headline: Review Score moved significantly (-0.835), but the evidence cannot identify a single cause.

scenarios.title: Goias - normal variation
scenarios.blurb: A dip that looks alarming on a dashboard and is statistically ordinary.
scenarios.headline: No investigation warranted: review_score is within normal variation.

scenarios.title: Para - measurement artefact
scenarios.blurb: Integrity checks flag the metric itself before any cause is reported.
scenarios.headline: The metric movement appears to be a measurement artefact.

scenarios.title: Average order value - restricted
scenarios.blurb: A confidential KPI. The operations reader is told what is withheld, not shown a redacted number.
scenarios.headline: Aov moved significantly (-67.233), but the evidence cannot identify a single cause.

scenarios.title: On-time delivery - second KPI
scenarios.blurb: A different KPI over the same sources, at the same grain.
scenarios.headline: On Time fell 0.108 (0.95 to 0.84). Leading cause: Delivery performance degraded, and that degradation drove the satisfaction drop.
